passages.note: Enacted text (Chapter 197) printing the operative provision; it names no voter or sponsor.

rows.reasoning: Ortiz co-sponsored and voted Y on HB2721 (2024), which forces larger municipalities to permit duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and townhomes and bars them from restricting middle housing, so it removes the zoning limits named in "at most, cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building" and is on-question. But one deregulation law shows only direction: it cannot establish that she would go no further, so it does not exclude "set binding rules on the private market like rent caps or required affordable units" or "offer subsidies and tax breaks so more affordable housing gets built". No surviving passage separates the rungs on that side.
